title: Практикум Недели 3: Архитектурные паттерны в эквайринге Avtobys
description:
В транспортной системе Avtobys возникла задача интегрировать внешний банковский шлюз (Kaspi Bank), обеспечить прозрачный аудит транзакций и реализовать многоступенчатую валидацию платежей перед их отправкой в банк.

Вам предстоит реализовать три классических паттерна GoF:
1. Adapter (Адаптер): KaspiBankAdapter адаптирует несовместимый KaspiBankProtocol к доменному интерфейсу PaymentProcessor.
2. Decorator (Декоратор): AuditLoggingDecorator оборачивает процессор платежей и прозрачно логирует каждую транзакцию.
3. Chain of Responsibility (Цепочка обязанностей): цепочка ValidationHandler (StopListHandler -> LimitCheckHandler) проверяет права пользователя и лимит суммы.
invariants: PaymentProcessor — чистый абстрактный базовый класс (ABC) с методом process_payment(user_id: str, amount: Decimal) -> bool.
KaspiBankAdapter строго реализует PaymentProcessor, конвертирует Decimal в целочисленные тенге (int) и отклоняет неположительные суммы (<= 0) до обращения к банку.
AuditLoggingDecorator наследует TransactionDecorator, не ломает интерфейс PaymentProcessor и сохраняет аудит-записи в список log.
Звенья ValidationHandler поддерживают свободный чейнинг через set_next(handler) и прерывают валидацию при первом обнаруженном нарушении.
requirements: Реализовать KaspiBankProtocol с методом execute_payment(account: str, amount_kzt: int) -> dict.
Создать абстрактный интерфейс PaymentProcessor с абстрактным методом process_payment.
Реализовать KaspiBankAdapter(PaymentProcessor), адаптирующий протокол Kaspi к доменному интерфейсу.
Создать базовый декоратор TransactionDecorator(PaymentProcessor) и конкретный AuditLoggingDecorator(TransactionDecorator) со списком log.
Реализовать цепочку обязанностей ValidationHandler с поддержкой set_next() и конкретные звенья StopListHandler и LimitCheckHandler.
Реализовать функцию сборки build_payment_system() для подготовки готовой к работе платежной подсистемы.
test_code:
from decimal import Decimal
from abc import ABC
import pytest
from solution import (
    KaspiBankProtocol,
    PaymentProcessor,
    KaspiBankAdapter,
    TransactionDecorator,
    AuditLoggingDecorator,
    ValidationHandler,
    StopListHandler,
    LimitCheckHandler,
    build_payment_system,
)


def test_kaspi_protocol_mock():
    """KaspiBankProtocol correctly processes payments and returns dict."""
    proto = KaspiBankProtocol()
    ok_res = proto.execute_payment(account="user_1", amount_kzt=150)
    assert ok_res["status"] == "OK"
    assert "tx_id" in ok_res

    fail_res = proto.execute_payment(account="user_1", amount_kzt=0)
    assert fail_res["status"] == "FAIL"


def test_payment_processor_is_abstract():
    """PaymentProcessor must be an abstract base class with process_payment method."""
    assert issubclass(PaymentProcessor, ABC)
    assert hasattr(PaymentProcessor, "process_payment")
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        PaymentProcessor()  # Cannot instantiate abstract class


def test_kaspi_adapter_implements_processor():
    """KaspiBankAdapter implements PaymentProcessor interface."""
    proto = KaspiBankProtocol()
    adapter = KaspiBankAdapter(proto)
    assert isinstance(adapter, PaymentProcessor)
    assert adapter.process_payment("user_10", Decimal("150")) is True


def test_kaspi_adapter_amount_validation():
    """KaspiBankAdapter rejects zero or negative amounts without calling bank."""
    proto = KaspiBankProtocol()
    adapter = KaspiBankAdapter(proto)
    assert adapter.process_payment("user_1", Decimal("0")) is False
    assert adapter.process_payment("user_1", Decimal("-100")) is False


def test_kaspi_adapter_handles_bank_failure():
    """KaspiBankAdapter returns False when bank returns status != 'OK'."""
    class FailingBankProtocol(KaspiBankProtocol):
        def execute_payment(self, account: str, amount_kzt: int) -> dict:
            return {"status": "FAIL", "error": "Declined"}

    adapter = KaspiBankAdapter(FailingBankProtocol())
    assert adapter.process_payment("user_1", Decimal("150")) is False


def test_transaction_decorator_is_abstract_and_delegates():
    """TransactionDecorator implements PaymentProcessor and delegates to wrapped instance."""
    assert issubclass(TransactionDecorator, PaymentProcessor)
    proto = KaspiBankProtocol()
    adapter = KaspiBankAdapter(proto)
    dec = TransactionDecorator(adapter)
    assert dec.process_payment("user_test", Decimal("500")) is True


def test_audit_logging_decorator_records_logs():
    """AuditLoggingDecorator logs all payment attempts with parameters and outcome."""
    proto = KaspiBankProtocol()
    adapter = KaspiBankAdapter(proto)
    auditor = AuditLoggingDecorator(adapter)

    assert isinstance(auditor, PaymentProcessor)
    assert isinstance(auditor, TransactionDecorator)
    assert auditor.log == []

    res_ok = auditor.process_payment("user_ok", Decimal("250"))
    assert res_ok is True
    assert len(auditor.log) == 1
    assert "AUDIT: user=user_ok, amount=250, success=True" in auditor.log[0]

    res_fail = auditor.process_payment("user_fail", Decimal("-10"))
    assert res_fail is False
    assert len(auditor.log) == 2
    assert "AUDIT: user=user_fail, amount=-10, success=False" in auditor.log[1]


def test_validation_handler_chain_linking():
    """ValidationHandler set_next supports fluent chaining and default delegation."""
    h1 = ValidationHandler()
    h2 = ValidationHandler()
    chained = h1.set_next(h2)
    assert chained is h2
    assert h1.validate({"user_id": "u1", "amount": Decimal("100")}) is True


def test_stop_list_handler():
    """StopListHandler blocks users in stop-list and passes others."""
    handler = StopListHandler(blocked_users={"blocked_passenger", "fraud_user"})
    assert handler.validate({"user_id": "normal_user", "amount": Decimal("150")}) is True
    assert handler.validate({"user_id": "blocked_passenger", "amount": Decimal("150")}) is False


def test_limit_check_handler():
    """LimitCheckHandler blocks transactions exceeding maximum limit."""
    handler = LimitCheckHandler(max_limit=Decimal("5000"))
    assert handler.validate({"user_id": "user_1", "amount": Decimal("150")}) is True
    assert handler.validate({"user_id": "user_1", "amount": Decimal("5000")}) is True
    assert handler.validate({"user_id": "user_1", "amount": Decimal("5001")}) is False


def test_full_validation_chain_execution():
    """Full chain (StopList -> LimitCheck) validates transaction properly."""
    stop_handler = StopListHandler(blocked_users={"bad_guy"})
    limit_handler = LimitCheckHandler(max_limit=Decimal("2000"))
    stop_handler.set_next(limit_handler)

    assert stop_handler.validate({"user_id": "good_guy", "amount": Decimal("1000")}) is True
    assert stop_handler.validate({"user_id": "bad_guy", "amount": Decimal("1000")}) is False
    assert stop_handler.validate({"user_id": "good_guy", "amount": Decimal("3000")}) is False


def test_build_payment_system_factory():
    """build_payment_system creates configured chain and decorated processor."""
    chain, processor = build_payment_system(
        blocked_users={"blocked_1"},
        max_limit=Decimal("4000"),
    )
    assert isinstance(chain, ValidationHandler)
    assert isinstance(processor, AuditLoggingDecorator)

    tx_valid = {"user_id": "passenger_x", "amount": Decimal("150")}
    assert chain.validate(tx_valid) is True
    assert processor.process_payment(tx_valid["user_id"], tx_valid["amount"]) is True
    assert len(processor.log) == 1
